overview_description.description:
N26 offers mobile banking solutions to customers in the European Union through its subsidiary. It provides international money transfer, investment, overdraft, and cash withdrawal and deposits at stores. 

N26 provides mobile banking services for customers. Its mobile banking services offer online banking that includes making and handling of current accounts, fixed accounts, and other banking services, letting customers manage and control their banking details via a smartphone application easily.

about_short_description.short_description: N26 is a financial services company that offers mobile banking solutions.

product.name: N26 Personal Bank Accounts
product.description: Mobile current accounts managed through the N26 app, supporting payments, transfers, cash withdrawals, virtual and physical Mastercard cards, and account-management features.

product.name: N26 Business Accounts
product.description: Mobile business accounts for freelancers and business users, providing business banking, Mastercard payments, account management, and plan-based financial features.

product.name: N26 Cards and Payments
product.description: Virtual and physical Mastercard debit cards for online, in-store, and contactless payments, with transaction security and foreign-currency payment support.

product.name: N26 Instant Savings
product.description: An accessible savings account for holding deposits separately from everyday funds and earning variable interest linked to the European Central Bank rate.

product.name: N26 Investments
product.description: An in-app investment service offering stocks, ETFs, ready-made funds, and automated investment plans through the N26 platform.

product.name: N26 Crypto
product.description: A mobile-app cryptocurrency trading service for buying and selling more than 400 crypto assets in real time, provided through Bitpanda.
